results.title: Charlton Athletic set to re-sign former loan star with medical scheduled ahead of permanent move
results.description: Charlton Athletic are finalising the permanent signing of Crystal Palace winger Jesurun Rak-Sakyi, with a medical set to take place today. Charlton Athletic are eager to strengthen their squad before the summer transfer window ends as they look to push up the Championship table.
